name: The Plans God Has For Us
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly directs and establishes the plans and steps of His people, even as they trust and wait on Him with courage and faith. While human hearts may devise many plans, it is the counsel and guidance of the LORD that ultimately stands and leads the way. Believers are called to trust fully in the LORD rather than their own understanding, relying on His instruction and watchful care to guide their paths.
